key_insight: The paper derives a simple Lagrangian formulation for shallow water equations with constant potential vorticity, avoiding Clebsch variables and auxiliary fields.
engineering_relevance: This offers a cleaner theoretical foundation for geophysical flow modeling and may simplify analytical work on rotating shallow-water systems, especially in regimes near the equator.
method: Builds a Lagrangian description from the shallow water equations under the constant potential vorticity constraint.
Uses a gauge-field-inspired framework rather than Clebsch-like parametrization.
Applies group-theoretic symmetry analysis to obtain a new exact solution via conformal scaling symmetry.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a derived formulation and one new exact solution, but does not mention numerical experiments or benchmark evaluations.
watch_item: The formulation is specialized to constant potential vorticity, so applicability to more general shallow-water flows may be limited.
paper_title: A simple Lagrangian for shallow water equations with constant potential vorticity
